XTI_BROKER,SUBSTR (ENFR.DATA_STAT_TYP, 1, 1) AS XSN_ESTADO,ENFR.ORG_ID AS COD_ACAFROM,decode((select  FLD_VAL from ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ROWNUM=1),'FINANCIAL','B,03,SFE')) AS  COD_FINENT,decode((select  FLD_VAL from ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ROWNUM=1),'NON FINANCIAL','N,NFE',decode((select FLD_VAL from ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ROWNUM=1),'CLEARINGHOUSE','CH'),decode((select  FLD_VAL from ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ROWNUM=1),'FINANCIAL','B,03,SFE')) AS  COD_FINENTEM,decode((select  FLD_VAL from ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ROWNUM=1),'NON FINANCIAL','N,NFE',decode((select FLD_VAL from ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ROWNUM=1),'CLEARINGHOUSE','CH'),decode((select  FLD_VAL from ft_t_fea1 FEA1 WHERE FEA1.ENFR_OID=ENFR.ENFR_OID AND STAT_DEf_ID='TPFINF' AND ROWNUM=1),'FINANCIAL','B,03,SFE')) AS XSN_BANCO, (select FRCL.CL_VALUE from ft_t_frcl FRCL where FRCL.INST_MNEM=FRID.INST_MNEM) AS COD_SECBX FROM (SELECT FRID2.INST_MNEM, FRID2.FINR_ID FROM FT_T_FRID FRID2 WHERE FRID2.FINR_ID = :3 AND FRID2.FINSRL_ID_CTXT_TYP = 'MGCGLOID') FRID2,FT_T_ENFR ENFR, FT_T_FRID FRID WHERE ENFR.INST_MNEM = FRID.INST_MNEM AND FRID.FINR_ID=:1 AND ENFR.ORG_ID=:2 from FT_T_FIID where inst_mnem=FRID.INST_MNEM AND FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP='N.I.F.') AS COD_NIF,decode(substr((select distinct FIGU.DATA_STAT_TYP from ft_t_figu figu where FIGU.INST_MNEM= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FIGU.DATA_STAT_TYP is not null AND ROWNUM=1),1,1), 'A', 'A', 'B,R,P') AS XSN_ESTADO_AGC,(select figu.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='RESID_CO' AND FIGU.INST_MNEM= FRID.INST_MNEM) AS COD_PAISOALF,decode((select FIID.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP from ft_t_fiid fiid where fiid.inst_mnem = frid.inst_mnem and fiid.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP IN ('C.I.F', 'Not_Def', 'N.I.F', 'N.I.F.', 'C.I.F.')),'N.I.F','1',decode((select FIID.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP from ft_t_fiid fiid where fiid.inst_mnem = frid.inst_mnem and fiid.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP IN ('C.I.F', 'Not_Def', 'N.I.F', 'N.I.F.', 'C.I.F.')),'N.I.F.',1,decode((select FIID.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP from ft_t_fiid fiid where fiid.inst_mnem = frid.inst_mnem and fiid.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP IN ('C.I.F', 'Not_Def', 'N.I.F', 'N.I.F.', 'C.I.F.')),'C.I.F','2',decode((select FIID.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP from ft_t_fiid fiid where fiid.inst_mnem = frid.inst_mnem and fiid.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP IN ('C.I.F', 'Not_Def', 'N.I.F', 'N.I.F.', 'C.I.F.')),'C.I.F.','2',decode((select FIID.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP from ft_t_fiid fiid where fiid.inst_mnem = frid.inst_mnem and fiid.FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP IN ('C.I.F', 'Not_Def', 'N.I.F', 'N.I.F.')),'Not_Def','3','NULL'))))) AS XTI_IDFISC25,(select fins_id from FT_T_FIID where inst_mnem=FRID.INST_MNEM AND FINS_ID_CTXT_TYP in ('C.I.F.','C.I.F','Not_Def','N.I.F','N.I.F.') AND ROWNUM=1)AS COD_IDFISC25,'NULL' as COD_TIPVIA,'NULL' AS DES_DIRECC,'NULL' AS QNU_CNUVIA,'NULL' AS DES_CRESTO,((SELECT MADR.CITY_NME FROM ft_t_madr madr, ft_t_adtp adtp WHERE MADR.MAIL_ADDR_ID = adtp.MAIL_ADDR_ID AND adtp.addr_typ='FISCAL' AND adtp.inst_mnem = frid.inst_mnem)) AS DES_PLAZAMT,(select FIGU.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where FIGU.INST_MNEM = frid.inst_mnem AND FIGU.GU_TYP='CITY' AND FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='ORIGTOWN') AS DES_PLAZAINT,'XTI_LOCALIZ' AS XTI_LOCALIZ,'NULL' AS COD_IDLEGALC,decode((select FIGU.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where figu.inst_mnem= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='NON_RES' AND FIGU.GU_TYP='COUNTRY' AND ROWNUM=1),'GB','S','NULL') AS XSN_RESLOND, decode((select FIGU.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where figu.inst_mnem= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='NON_RES' AND FIGU.GU_TYP='COUNTRY' AND ROWNUM=1),'US','S','NULL') AS XSN_RESNY,decode((select FIGU.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where figu.inst_mnem= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='NON_RES' AND FIGU.GU_TYP='COUNTRY' AND ROWNUM=1),'IT','S','NULL') AS XSN_RESMILAN, decode((select FIGU.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where figu.inst_mnem= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='NON_RES' AND FIGU.GU_TYP='COUNTRY' AND ROWNUM=1),'FR','S','NULL') AS XSN_RESBRUSE,decode((select FIGU.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where figu.inst_mnem= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='NON_RES' AND FIGU.GU_TYP='COUNTRY' AND ROWNUM=1),'US','S','NULL') AS XSN_RESNI,decode((select FIGU.GU_ID from ft_t_figu figu where figu.inst_mnem= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FIGU.FINS_GU_PURP_TYP='NON_RES' AND FIGU.GU_TYP='COUNTRY' AND ROWNUM=1),'ES','S','NULL') AS XSN_RESMADR,FINS.INST_LEGAL_NME AS DES_ENTLEGAL,(select frid2.FINR_ID from ft_t_frid frid2 where FRID2.INST_MNEM= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FRID2.FINSRL_ID_CTXT_TYP='RED' AND ROWNUM=1) AS DES_CORTA,(select finr_id from ft_t_frid where frid.inst_mnem= FRID.INST_MNEM AND FRID.FINSRL_ID_CTXT_TYP='') AS VAL_PARAM, FINS.INST_LEGAL_NME,FINS.INST_NME,(SELECT CST_NME FROM FT_T_CUST CUST WHERE CUST.INST_MNEM = FRID.INST_MNEM) AS CST_NME,(SELECT CUCH.PRSNL_SAL_TXT FROM FT_T_CUST CUST, FT_T_CUCH CUCH WHERE CUST.INST_MNEM = FRID.INST_MNEM AND CUST.CST_ID =CUCH.CST_ID) AS COD_TRATDEF,decode(trim(FINS.NLS_CDE),'SPANISH','1',decode(trim(FINS.NLS_CDE),'ENGLISH','2',decode(trim(FINS.NLS_CDE),'FRENCH','3','NULL'))) AS COD_IDIOMINT_EMA, decode(trim(FINS.NLS_CDE),'SPANISH','E',decode(trim(FINS.NLS_CDE),'ENGLISH','I',decode(trim(FINS.NLS_CDE),'FRENCH','F','NULL'))) AS COD_IDIOMINT_AGC,decode((SELECT FIST.STAT_CHAR_VAL_TXT FROM FT_T_FIST FIST WHERE FIST.INST_MNEM = FRID.INST_MNEM),'Y','42,47,87','NULL') AS QNU_CODINSTI,decode((SELECT FIST.STAT_CHAR_VAL_TXT FROM FT_T_FIST FIST WHERE FIST.INST_MNEM = FRID.INST_MNEM),'Y','6511,6622','NULL') AS COD_CNAE5,(select figu.gu_id FROM ft_t_figu figu WHERE FRID.INST_MNEM = figu.INST_MNEM AND figu.fins_gu_purp_typ = 'ORIGTOWN') AS COD_PLAZAINT,(SELECT frid2.FINR_ID FROM ft_t_frid frid2 WHERE FRID2.INST_MNEM = FRID.INST_MNEM AND FRID2.FINSRL_ID_CTXT_TYP = 'MISYSID' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS DES_VALPARAM FROM ft_t_frid frid, ft_t_fins fins WHERE FRID.INST_MNEM = FINS.INST_MNEM AND FRID.FINR_ID=:1

csw.columns=COD_CNTABACO,COD_CTPDA,COD_INTSWIFT,COD_SWIFT
